Speech.NativeText: Hey, I could use some help. I need to go meet... someone. Could you back me up?
:-) Sure, I got your back anytime.
Sorry, I've got problems of my own right now.
%1. So this is where you've been hiding.
}:-| I'm not going back with you.
}:-| Doesn't look like you have much of a choice. You know the penalty for desertion!
8-( I was told this would just be a negotiation! }:-| I live here now!
}:-| It's a negotiation, but not with you. Where is your leader?
}:-| It's a negotiation, but not with you.
{:-| %1... %2 isn't here. Whatever you have to say, you can say to me.
}:-) Oh, sounds like you found yourself a real tight little group! }:-| Well here's your negotiation, %1. Come back with me, or suffer the full penalty for disloyalty.
}:-[ You'll never take me alive!
{:-[ You know what, I don't care anyway. %1 can go to hell, I can't believe I ever thought %2 would come through for me.

}:-| Yeah well done, you fucking prick, you made the right choice finally. :-| Once you've served out your punishment duties, and if you survive the beatings of course, you'll be back to regular labor duties pretty soon. I mean it'll probably only take a few years.

%1 needs to come back with us now. If you try to resist, we will send our enforcers to crush you. But we don't want to inconvenience you. As a token of our deep respect for you, we'll offer you 500 gold in compensation if you do the right thing and hand %2 over peacefully.
}:-| Don't get any cute ideas though, the gold isn't on me now. It'll be left in a hidden location for you to retrieve after we have secured this... traitor.
What will happen to %1?

We take disloyalty very seriously, because that's what we need to do to survive! But don't worry, %1 won't be executed. %2 will have to perform some unpleasant chores for a time, and %3 may lose some.. non-essential body parts. :-) But in the end %4 will be forgiven.
How do I know I can trust you?
Always a difficult question these days, isn't it? But if we wanted, we could kill you all now. We have the soldiers, and the weapons. %1 can vouch for that. }:-| Don't make the stupid choice.
{:-| I'm sorry, %1. You have to go with them.
}:-| %1 is my friend. If you want %2, you'll have to come through me.
8-( N.. no..! Don't do this to me, %1!
{:-( This is killing me, but I need to think of the safety of everyone in %1.
{:-| It's every man for himself in this world, you know that.
{:-( It's not my fault, they're too powerful. I can't fight them.
{:-[ I should never have let myself trust you.
Look man, I want the gold. You'd do the same to me.
}:-) I have snipers poised to take you out. {:-| Go home, and say you couldn't find %1.
8-( Uh... I may have misread the situation. Now that I see %1 up close %2 looks kinda different. I think we got the wrong %3. Let's go, squad.
}:-[ Don't bullshit me, it won't end well for you.
We still have your friends. Do you want them to go on suffering? We can end it, if you come back.
}:-| You'll keep torturing them anyway, I'm not stupid. }:-[ I was told this would just be a negotiation for their release! {:-[ I can get you gold!
}:-) Oh, sounds like they really look after you here! }:-| Come back to the cage, at least we feed you. Or, we can bring you back in pieces and feed you to your friends. Your choice!
}:-) Good %1. They'll be real happy to see you.
}:-| Don't get any cute ideas though, the gold isn't on me now. It'll be left in a hidden location for you to retrieve after we have secured the prisoner.
:-) That's none of your concern. But don't worry, we're not going to kill %1, }:-[ as much as %2 deserves it. :-) We have a use for %3.
{:-) I believe you do. :-| Yes. They said they would meet me near %1, and I could bring.. uh, a representative of my group.
What's it about?
{:-| Okay.

It's... not a big deal, just something I need to sort out. Before I joined you a passing trader told me they were looking for me, and they'd be here now, and I should go to them. It'll be fine. I'm sure it'll be fine.
}:-[ Too late for you to back out of this!
8-( Uh.. you know that gang that came looking for me? We've got radio reports saying they've sent more enforcers. Let's get prepared, these guys don't fuck around.
}:-| Hey remember the dickheads that tried to abduct me? }:-[ They're back with more enforcers. Let's give them a welcome they won't forget.
Oh I hear my old friends are in town, and they'd like to pay us a visit. How lovely. Do we have any vodka? Let's mix some drinks, if you know what I mean.
}:-[ Incoming! It's those creeps that captured %1 before. They are deadly, be prepared!
}:-[ Watch out! It's those assholes %1 used to work for. They are dangerous, get ready!
{:-( For fucks sake help me!
{:-( I don't want to talk to you!
}:-| Our business is concluded.

Quest.NativeDescription: %1 wants %2 to go with %3 and meet %4 mysterious contact.
Wait for the tracker squad to deposit the gold and leave. Or you could still rescue %1.
You could still rescue %1, or just let the tracker squad leave and they won't bother you again.

Invader.NativeDescription: Looks like %1 used to know some real assholes before %2 came here, and now they're angry at you too!
Apparently %1 was held captive by some creepy strangers before coming here, and they aren't happy %2 escaped.
